messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?
I want a fair financial share. I haven’t agreed to A buying the house at a discount, and I won’t subsidize that. I do want us to settle it without hurting each other, but there’s no need to rush.
I’d like to buy the house with my husband at a family discount and make it our home. C’s agreement is needed, and she hasn’t agreed yet.

Thank you. What matters most to me is having some money available to start a dance studio. That’s the plan I have in mind, though I don’t know what amount or arrangement might be possible yet. I’d like that to be considered as we talk about the house and the will.
Those fit. I’d add that I haven’t agreed to A buying the house at a discount, and I won’t subsidize it.

That mostly fits. The discount is about affordability; it would make buying the house more realistic for us. I’d also like it to remain a family home, but I don’t want to assume everyone feels the same.

Yes, that mostly fits. I’d say, “I’d like enough money, when it’s possible, to get my dance studio started.” I don’t have a particular attachment to the house itself. I’d appreciate having time to consider any proposals before we decide anything.
Yes, that fits. I’d say “what I inherit” rather than “my share,” but the point is right.
Yes, both fit. I do worry my wish to buy it could seem like I’m putting my interests ahead of C’s fair share. I don’t want to rush or damage our relationship.
Yes, that fits. Thank you for recording it.
Yes, draft 8 fits. X and Y make me uneasy because a full-value buyout may not be affordable; I was hoping for a family discount. I’d also need C’s agreement.
No major discomfort, as long as these are only options, not decisions. The appraisal, shares, and terms still need to be agreed; I’m not agreeing to B being paid first or to any particular plan yet.

Y is the one I’d be most interested in, since staged payments might make the studio possible sooner. I’d feel a little uneasy about my portion being paid first unless C felt it was fair too, and I’d need to understand the terms before considering it.
